ACT XI OF 2020
ACT XI OF 2020
PUNJAB LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Punjab Local
Government Act, 2019
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd July, 2020]
This
Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 26 June 2020;
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 01 July 2020; and, was published
in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary), dated: 02 July 2020, pp. 85.
It
is necessary further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of
2019) for the purpose hereinafter appearing.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3 of Act XIII of 2019

ACT XI OF 2020

Government Act, 2019
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd July, 2020]
This
Act was passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 26 June 2020;
assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 01 July 2020; and, was published
in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary), dated: 02 July 2020, pp. 85.
It
is necessary further to amend the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of
2019) for the purpose hereinafter appearing.
Be
it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 3 of Act XIII of 2019.---In
the Punjab Local Government Act, 2019 (XIII of 2019), in section 3, in
subsection (2), for the words "one year", the words "twenty one
months" shall be substituted.

Repeal
